content:
It was awesome heading back to UNC Charlotte as an alumna, this time representing Wells Fargo alongside Josh G. to talk about our technology programs!

Being a student there not too long ago and now coming back to speak with students about technology and cybersecurity was such a full-circle moment. It was great connecting with all the students who stopped by and hearing about their interests. It definitely brought back so many memories!

Huge thank you to Jay Skipworth for inviting us!
comment: Industry exposure early in a student's journey can be a major differentiator. The strongest programs often bridge the gap by showing not just tools and roles, but how security decisions impact real businesses.
